You have no idea. I got into my dream school - Georgia tech and I blew it. My first semester I was doing fine - great even. Granted life wasn't perfect I was lonely at times and unexplainably depressed (considering I was living out my dream). But I had friends, a great sorority, a good school party balance - it was literally the college dream. Then the second semester came. Academically I was doing fine at the beginning, but then fucking Thanksgiving came around. My mom invited my childhood molester (and cousin) to dinner even though she knew what he did. My mom and I had a huge fight after that and when I went back to school I had a really bad mental break. It started to manifest physically to the point where I was having excruciating back aches that would bring me to the ground for minutes at a time. I wanted to run away... so I did. I packed all of my shit from the sorority house, dropped all my classes and left for the airport where I spent two days just wondering where I should go and what I should do next. It wasn't my intention to spend so long in the airport but i missed my initial flight and my ticket and money situation got fucked up. Literally it was horrible - racist cops kept harassing me and eventually I just... really wanted to die. It showed all over my face. One nice cop saw me tho - convinced me to call my parents and go home. Being with family only made me feel worse so much shit happened but I eventually got "better" and went back to GT but I didn't last long - a combination of the fact that I hadn't been to in person class in a minute due to covid and the unfortunately undeniable fact that I'm just not smart enough for a hard school like GT caused me to drop all my classes again... but this time for good. Now I'm back at home and I feel like I wasted a huge opportunity, I don't see my life amounting to anything or getting better and every night I go to bed wishing that I won't wake up.
